I'm Tristan Labagala, a Monash University Commerce and IT student majoring in Business Analytics and Business Information Systems, graduating in November 2026. The problems I like most start with messy data and end with a decision someone has to make.

Outside of work, I enjoy playing and refereeing basketball. I am currently undertaking my Level 1 accreditation, with hopes to referee on the Victorian Junior Basketball League (VJBL) panel in 2027, which is the highest junior state league in Victoria.
